Job Description Are you an experienced Field Service Engineer who enjoys traveling, solving technical challenges, and working on advanced industrial machinery? Do you want to be part of an international organization where no two projects are the same? Then this opportunity could be the perfect fit. As a Field Service Engineer, you will be responsible for the installation, commissioning, maintenance, and troubleshooting of high-end process equipment and complete production systems at customer sites around the world. You will act as the technical representative on-site, ensuring installations are delivered safely, efficiently, and to the highest quality standards. Working closely with Engineering, Project Management, and Service teams, you will play a key role throughout the entire project lifecycle while building strong relationships with customers worldwide. Your responsibilities Install and commission industrial machinery and complete production lines at customer sites. Perform preventive maintenance, inspections, and repairs. Diagnose and resolve mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and control system faults. Test, optimize, and fine-tune equipment to ensure optimal performance. Train and support operators and maintenance teams. Prepare service reports and provide technical recommendations for improvements. Collaborate with Engineering and Project Management to successfully complete projects. Ensure all work is carried out in accordance with safety and quality standards. Arbeidsvoorwaarden You will join an internationally operating machine builder where innovation, technology, and personal development are at the heart of the business. We offer: A competitive salary based on your knowledge and experience. Attractive international travel and daily allowances. Annual bonus scheme. 27 vacation days plus 13 additional ADV (reduction of working hours) days. Excellent pension scheme. Company laptop, mobile phone, and professional tools. Extensive training and career

development opportunities. The opportunity to work on challenging international projects. A high level of independence and responsibility. Functie-eisen We are looking for a hands-on engineer with a passion for technology and international travel. You have: An MBO Level 4 or Bachelor's degree in Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field. Experience as a Field Service Engineer, Commissioning Engineer, or Service Technician within machine building or industrial automation. Knowledge of mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and preferably PLC-controlled systems. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Good communication skills in English (Dutch is an advantage). A willingness to travel internationally on a regular basis. A valid driver's license (Category B). A customer-focused and independent working attitude. Hier kom je te werken Our client is a globally recognized machine builder specializing in the design, production, and maintenance of advanced process equipment and complete production facilities for the feed and food processing industry. From its modern headquarters in the Netherlands, the company designs, manufactures, assembles, and services complete turnkey installations for customers across the globe. Innovation, quality, and continuous improvement are deeply embedded in the company culture, creating an environment where employees are encouraged to develop both professionally and personally.

Company Description CoCo Yachts B.V. is a ship and yacht design company based in the Randstad region of the Netherlands, focusing on innovative, efficient, and safe vessel concepts. The company works closely with clients, shipyards, and marine suppliers to deliver practical designs that meet operational and regulatory requirements. Team members are encouraged to contribute ideas, take ownership of their work, and support continuous improvement in design and engineering processes. 
The Naval Architect position is a full-time, on-site role located in Gorinchem (the Randstad), the Netherlands. In this position, the Naval Architect prepares detailed 2D and 3D drawings, plans, and construction documentation for various vessel types, working closely with senior naval architects and engineers. Daily tasks include performing basic calculations, assisting with structural layouts, checking drawings against regulatory and class requirements, and coordinating technical information with shipyards and suppliers. The role also involves supporting design reviews, updating documentation based on feedback, and ensuring that all plans meet quality, safety, and performance standards. The team member is expected to collaborate with colleagues, communicate clearly, and manage tasks within agreed timelines.

jobs.occupation: Warehouse Team Leader - DHL Supply Chain | Eersel
jobs.description:
Ready to lead a team and make an impact every day? For DHL Supply Chain at the Vencomatic site in Eersel, we are looking for an experienced and motivated Warehouse Team Leader. In this role, you will be responsible for leading a team, managing daily operations, and ensuring that safety, quality, and performance remain at a high level. Are you a natural leader who knows how to motivate people, keep a clear overview, and take action when needed? Then this could be the next step in your career. Wie zoeken we? At least 1 year of experience as a Team Leader, Supervisor, or Lead Operator. Strong communication skills in English. Skilled in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint) and WMS. Hands-on, proactive, and fully committed to safety and quality. The ability to motivate and develop a team. What does DHL Supply Chain offer? Kickstart your career with one of the world’s most respected logistics companies, where stability, great working conditions, and growth opportunities go hand in hand. Competitive gross monthly salary: €3,039 – €3,500, with potential to grow up to €4,490. 25 vacation days to recharge. Company laptop and mobile phone to stay connected Travel allowance and pension plan Lots of opportunities to learn and grow within DHL Supply Chain Take the next step in your career and become part of a team where your skills make a real impact. Functieomschrijving As a Warehouse Team Leader, you’ll lead a team of around 20 Warehouse Operators. You energize your team, keep operations running smoothly, and drive for continuous improvement every day. You’ll work in rotating shifts (06:00–15:00 and 15:00–00:00) and focus on: Leading, coaching, and developing your team. Monitoring daily operations and responding quickly to challenges. Ensuring compliance with safety, quality, and operational procedures. Leading key HR meetings (absence, performance, development) Creating clear reports and analyses in the Warehouse Management System (WMS) You’ll work closely with fellow Team

Leaders, Shift Manager, and the Operations Manager to keep processes aligned and targets on track. In short: you fuel the connection between people, processes, and performance.
